import argparse
import sys

def createparser():
    """Create an argument parser for the pysemver CLI."""
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog='pysemver',
        description='Semantic Versioning command-line tool'
    )
    
    subparsers = parser.add_subparsers(dest='command')
    
    # Compare command
    compare_parser = subparsers.add_parser('compare', help='Compare two versions')
    compare_parser.add_argument('version1', help='First version')
    compare_parser.add_argument('version2', help='Second version')
    
    # Bump commands
    bump_parser = subparsers.add_parser('bump', help='Bump a version component')
    bump_parser.add_argument('version', help='Version to bump')
    bump_parser.add_argument('component', choices=['major', 'minor', 'patch', 'prerelease', 'build'], 
                            help='Component to bump')
    
    # Finalize command
    finalize_parser = subparsers.add_parser('finalize', help='Remove prerelease and build metadata')
    finalize_parser.add_argument('version', help='Version to finalize')
    
    return parser

def process(args):
    """Process the parsed arguments."""
    if args.command == 'compare':
        result = compare(args.version1, args.version2)
        print(result)
    elif args.command == 'bump':
        if args.component == 'major':
            print(bump_major(args.version))
        elif args.component == 'minor':
            print(bump_minor(args.version))
        elif args.component == 'patch':
            print(bump_patch(args.version))
        elif args.component == 'prerelease':
            print(bump_prerelease(args.version))
        elif args.component == 'build':
            print(bump_build(args.version))
    elif args.command == 'finalize':
        print(finalize_version(args.version))
